_README: SANITIZED ILLUSTRATION — NOT A DROP-IN IMPORT.
This is a genericized version of a production n8n workflow, published as a portfolio code sample.
All credentials, internal hostnames, schema names, table/column names, and client identifiers
have been removed or replaced with neutral placeholders. The control flow and SQL/JS logic are
faithful to the original pattern; the names are not. Do not expect it to run as-is.
Pattern: an internal self-serve form lets a non-technical user pick from the CANONICAL
taxonomy values, which constrains the query at the input layer (no free-text category
mismatch). The result set is converted to CSV and returned. Original turnaround dropped
from ~3 days (ticket queue) to under 20 minutes.
name: demander-export-self-serve (sanitized)

parameters.query:
-- Constrained by the canonical taxonomy values chosen in the form,
-- so a non-technical user cannot submit a category that doesn't exist.
SELECT p.brand, p.product_name, p.colour, p.match_key, p.rrp,
       p.category_level_1, p.category_level_2, p.category_level_3
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_level_1 = $1
  AND p.category_level_2 = $2
ORDER BY p.brand, p.product_name
LIMIT COALESCE($3, 5000);
